hotels.name: The Imperial New Delhi
hotels.description: A living legend in the heart of Lutyens' Delhi, The Imperial has defined gracious hospitality since 1936. Its white colonnaded façade, art deco interiors, and a collection of over 5,000 rare artworks make it one of Asia's finest heritage properties. Home to celebrated restaurants 1911 and Spice Route, a tranquil spa, and lushly landscaped gardens — every stay is a journey through India's colonial grandeur.

hotels.name: Taj Holiday Village Resort & Spa
hotels.description: Nestled between swaying coconut palms and the golden sands of Calangute Beach, Taj Holiday Village is Goa's most beloved resort destination. Portuguese-style cottages with private verandahs dot the 26-acre property, while three pools, a world-class Jiva Spa, and six dining outlets ensure there is never a dull moment. The resort blends Goan warmth with Taj's legendary service to create an unmatched coastal escape.

hotels.name: Lemon Tree Hotel Candolim, Goa
hotels.description: Bright, cheerful, and refreshingly affordable — Lemon Tree Hotel Candolim is the smart traveller's choice in Goa. Located just 10 minutes from Calangute Beach and close to major highway connections, it serves both leisure and business guests with well-appointed rooms, a rooftop pool, and the signature Citrus Café. The hotel's vibrant yellow-and-green interiors bring Goa's sunny spirit indoors.

hotels.name: Zostel Goa (Anjuna)
hotels.description: India's most loved hostel brand, Zostel Anjuna is where backpackers become friends. Set 200 metres from the legendary Anjuna Flea Market and a short walk to the beach, the hostel offers private rooms, mixed and female-only dorms, a buzzing common area, hammock garden, and a café serving all-day food and drinks. Free walking tours, surf lessons, and evening bonfires make every stay an adventure.

location.address: H.No 894, Anjuna Beach Road, Near Flea Market

hotels.name: Novotel New Delhi Aerocity
hotels.description: The closest 5-star hotel to Indira Gandhi International Airport, Novotel Aerocity combines contemporary luxury with seamless connectivity. Its 390 elegantly designed rooms offer stunning runway views, while the award-winning SpaNovotel, a rooftop infinity pool, and five dining outlets cater to every taste. The hotel's sky bridge connects directly to the Aerocity Metro Station, making it the ultimate transit hub for the discerning traveller.

hotels.name: Taj Mahal Palace, Mumbai
hotels.description: Standing majestically at the Gateway of India since 1903, the Taj Mahal Palace is more than a hotel — it is a national icon. Its Indo-Saracenic dome, stunning harbour views, and legendary service have welcomed royalty, heads of state, and discerning travellers for over a century. The Palace wing houses museum-quality antiques and original artwork, while Harbour Bar — India's oldest licensed bar — remains a Mumbai institution. Recognised as one of the Leading Hotels of the World.

hotels.name: ITC Maratha, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Mumbai
hotels.description: A tribute to the valour and splendour of the Maratha Empire, ITC Maratha rises 10 storeys near Mumbai's international airport. The hotel's hand-painted murals, traditional Maratha motifs, and locally sourced teak furniture tell the story of Maharashtra's rich heritage. The award-winning Dum Pukht Maratha restaurant specialises in slow-cooked Mughlai cuisine, while Peshwa offers an extensive global buffet. A member of Marriott's Luxury Collection.

hotels.name: Rambagh Palace, Jaipur
hotels.description: Once the hunting lodge of Ram Singh II and later the official residence of the last Maharaja of Jaipur, Rambagh Palace is the crown jewel of Rajasthan's palace hotels. Set within 47 acres of Mughal gardens, its regal suites showcase original royal antiques, hand-embroidered fabrics, and ornate carved marble. The Suvarna Mahal restaurant — once the royal ballroom — offers an unrivalled fine-dining experience beneath gilded ceilings. Conde Nast Traveller's No. 1 Hotel in India.

hotels.name: Samode Haveli, Jaipur
hotels.description: Hidden behind a centuries-old gateway in the narrow lanes of old Jaipur, Samode Haveli is a jewel of Rajput architecture. This 475-year-old mansion, once home to the Prime Minister of Jaipur State, has been lovingly restored by the Samode family who still live here. Its hand-painted frescoes, mirrored Sheesh Mahal, courtyard plunge pool, and rooftop terrace with pink city views make it one of Rajasthan's most intimate heritage stays. Recognised by Condé Nast Traveller and Travel + Leisure.

itinerary_items.title: Flight to Delhi
itinerary_items.notes: IndiGo 6E-204. Web check-in done.

itinerary_items.title: Check-in: The Imperial New Delhi
itinerary_items.notes: Deluxe King room. Breakfast included.

itinerary_items.title: Taj Mahal Visit
itinerary_items.notes: Sunrise visit. Carry valid ID.

itinerary_items.title: Fly into New Delhi
itinerary_items.notes: Arrive at Terminal 3. Pre-book airport transfer to hotel.

itinerary_items.title: Guided Tour of Red Fort
itinerary_items.notes: Meet guide at Gate 1. Wear comfortable shoes.

itinerary_items.title: Explore Qutub Minar & Humayun's Tomb
itinerary_items.notes: UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Best visited in the morning.

itinerary_items.title: Train to Agra
itinerary_items.notes: Gatimaan Express. Duration: 1h 40m. Arrives Agra Cantonment.

itinerary_items.title: Taj Mahal Sunrise Visit
itinerary_items.notes: Entry opens at 6am. Book tickets online in advance. Avoid Fridays.

itinerary_items.title: Agra Fort & Mehtab Bagh
itinerary_items.notes: Agra Fort is a 15-min drive from Taj Mahal. Mehtab Bagh offers sunset views.

itinerary_items.title: Drive to Jaipur
itinerary_items.notes: Approx 4h drive. Stop at Fatehpur Sikri en route.

itinerary_items.title: Amber Fort Elephant Ride & Tour
itinerary_items.notes: Book elephant ride slot early. Guided tour included.

itinerary_items.title: City Palace & Hawa Mahal
itinerary_items.notes: Hawa Mahal best photographed from across the street at sunrise.

itinerary_items.title: Fly into Kochi
itinerary_items.notes: Air India recommended. Terminal 2 for domestic arrivals.

itinerary_items.title: Fort Kochi Walking Tour
itinerary_items.notes: See Chinese fishing nets, St. Francis Church & Dutch Palace.

itinerary_items.title: Kathakali Performance
itinerary_items.notes: Evening show at 6:30pm. Arrive 30 mins early for makeup demo.

itinerary_items.title: Drive to Alleppey
itinerary_items.notes: 1.5h drive. Check in to houseboat by 12pm.

itinerary_items.title: Houseboat Stay on Vembanad Lake
itinerary_items.notes: Full board meal plan. Sunset cruise included. AC cabin recommended.

itinerary_items.title: Canoe Ride through Village Canals
itinerary_items.notes: Early morning 6am slot recommended. Spot local village life.

itinerary_items.title: Kumarakom Bird Sanctuary
itinerary_items.notes: Best time: early morning. Spot migratory birds Nov–Feb.

itinerary_items.title: Shatabdi Express to Jaipur
itinerary_items.notes: Executive Class. Meal served on board. Duration: 4.5h.

itinerary_items.title: Amber Fort Sightseeing
itinerary_items.notes: Local guide provided. Carry water and hats.

itinerary_items.title: Jantar Mantar & City Palace
itinerary_items.notes: UNESCO site. Combo ticket available at the gate.

itinerary_items.title: Drive to Jodhpur
itinerary_items.notes: 5h drive. Stop at Ajmer Sharif Dargah en route.

itinerary_items.title: Mehrangarh Fort & Jaswant Thada
itinerary_items.notes: One of India's largest forts. Audio guide available at entrance.

itinerary_items.title: Drive to Udaipur
itinerary_items.notes: 5h scenic drive through Rajasthan countryside.

itinerary_items.title: City Palace & Lake Pichola Boat Ride
itinerary_items.notes: Evening boat ride recommended for views of Jag Mandir palace.

itinerary_items.title: Fly into Varanasi
itinerary_items.notes: Short 20 min drive to ghats area. Pre-book hotel near Assi Ghat.

itinerary_items.title: Sunrise Boat Ride on the Ganges
itinerary_items.notes: Start at 5:30am. Witness the morning aarti and daily rituals.

itinerary_items.title: Kashi Vishwanath Temple Visit
itinerary_items.notes: One of the 12 Jyotirlingas. Dress modestly. No phones inside.

itinerary_items.title: Drive to Sarnath
itinerary_items.notes: 13km, 30 min drive. Where Buddha gave his first sermon.

itinerary_items.title: Dhamek Stupa & Sarnath Museum
itinerary_items.notes: Museum has the original Ashoka Lion Capital. Opens at 9am.

itinerary_items.title: Ganga Aarti Ceremony
itinerary_items.notes: Evening aarti at 7pm. Arrive by 6:30pm for a good spot.

itinerary_items.title: Overnight Train to Hospet
itinerary_items.notes: Hampi Express departs 10pm. 9h journey. Book sleeper class.

itinerary_items.title: Virupaksha Temple & Hampi Bazaar
itinerary_items.notes: Still an active temple. Morning puja at 6am. Remove footwear.

itinerary_items.title: Vittala Temple & Stone Chariot
itinerary_items.notes: Musical pillars and iconic stone chariot. Best in morning light.

itinerary_items.title: Royal Enclosure & Elephant Stables
itinerary_items.notes: Zenana enclosure and Lotus Mahal also nearby. Allow 3 hours.

itinerary_items.title: Matanga Hill Sunrise Trek
itinerary_items.notes: 45 min climb. Start by 5:30am. Panoramic views of ruins.

itinerary_items.title: Drive from Bengaluru to Mysore
itinerary_items.notes: 3h drive on Mysore Road. KSRTC bus also available.

itinerary_items.title: Mysore Palace Tour
itinerary_items.notes: Palace is illuminated on Sundays and public holidays. Stunning sight.

itinerary_items.title: Chamundi Hills & Nandi Statue
itinerary_items.notes: 1000 steps to the top. Auto available from halfway point.

itinerary_items.title: Drive to Coorg
itinerary_items.notes: 2.5h scenic drive through coffee and spice plantations.

itinerary_items.title: Abbey Falls & Coffee Plantation Walk
itinerary_items.notes: Short 1km walk to falls. Coffee estate tour available nearby.

itinerary_items.title: Dubare Elephant Camp
itinerary_items.notes: Feed and bathe elephants. Morning session 8–10am only.

itinerary_items.title: Air India AI-560 — Chennai to Mumbai
itinerary_items.notes: Cabin: economy. Ref: TRV-8SUAC

itinerary_items.title: Hotel Check-in — Taj Holiday Village Resort
itinerary_items.notes: 1 nights. Ref: HTL-MNQJY7JV-4VP5

itinerary_items.title: Hotel Check-in — Lemon Tree Hotel
itinerary_items.notes: 1 nights. Ref: HTL-MNQXPA2X-XRED

itinerary_items.title: Fly to Leh
itinerary_items.notes: Air India AI-470. Early morning flight. Acclimatize on arrival.

itinerary_items.title: Check-in: The Grand Dragon, Leh
itinerary_items.notes: Rest day for acclimatization. Do not exert.

itinerary_items.title: Visit Shanti Stupa & Leh Palace
itinerary_items.notes: Early morning visit to Shanti Stupa for sunrise. Leh Palace gives panoramic views.

itinerary_items.title: Pangong Lake Day Trip
itinerary_items.notes: 5h drive each way. Carry warm clothes. Overnight camping optional.

itinerary_items.title: Nubra Valley via Khardung La
itinerary_items.notes: Highest motorable road. Double hump Bactrian camels at Hunder.

itinerary_items.title: Fly to Jaipur
itinerary_items.notes: Morning flight. Transfer to Rambagh Palace.

itinerary_items.title: Check-in: Rambagh Palace
itinerary_items.notes: 3 nights. Ref: HTL-USR6A-001

itinerary_items.title: Amber Fort & City Palace
itinerary_items.notes: Full day sightseeing. Book elephant ride in advance.

itinerary_items.title: Hawa Mahal & Jantar Mantar
itinerary_items.notes: Evening at Chokhi Dhani cultural village.

reviews.comment: Absolutely stunning heritage property. Service was impeccable.
Perfect beach resort. Loved every moment.
Great location. Rooms are spacious and very clean.
Exceptional experience at Novotel. The airport convenience is unmatched.
Beautiful property but service could be improved.
Great hotel to stay and enjoy the view
Loved the beachside location and the sunset views from the room. Staff were very attentive. Will definitely come back!
Shatabdi was clean and on time. Catering was decent. Great way to travel Bangalore to Chennai.
A truly royal experience. The Rambagh Palace is in a class of its own. Every detail, from the antique furniture to the butler service, was impeccable. Worth every rupee.
Good budget option in Goa. Rooms were clean and the rooftop pool was a nice touch. Location is slightly inland but manageable.
Samode Haveli is a hidden gem. The frescoes, the courtyard pool, the rooftop views — it felt like stepping back in time. The food was also excellent.
Beautiful heritage stay. Great ambience and warm hospitality. The Rajasthani dinner was a highlight!
Orange Travels was comfortable and punctual. The Volvo bus had good AC and the seats were spacious. Would use again.
